FN-3U1PVEV-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 46
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Parker Moore
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/19/2024
House Bill 46 as introduced could increase receipts of the Department of Revenue by $24.25
per permanent license plate issued for certain volunteer rescue squad vehicles and utility trailers,
as provided by this bill.
Page 1
